profile_text: Providing personnel services and recruitment solutions to diverse industries, this scaler company has established itself as a key player in the administrative and support service activities sector. With a focus on delivering tailored recruitment solutions, it has built a reputation for effectively meeting the staffing needs of its clients, despite experiencing a 23.3% decline in employees since its baseline. As a specialist in personnel services, it continues to navigate the market with 171 employees in 2024.
